correctness.rationale: The finite generic square-fiber orbit proof is obtained from the Plücker equations, and normality follows from the normal isotropic-cone product and orthogonal invariant ring (using published hollow-rank-three ideal). Thus the quotient is the original X_n, not just its normalization. Every group stabilizer is enumerated using eigenspace splittings, all nonidentity tangent involutions have at least two negative directions, and the quotient singular set equals the fixed images. Irreducible strata, dimensions, generic stabilizer, completed transverse quotient rings, Reid–Tai age and Watanabe determinants establish every asserted conclusion; verify.py finitely checks sign patterns n=4..6, tangent dimensions n=4..12, and exact n=5 minor Jacobians, but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Projection DPPs and squared Plücker varieties motivate the entire natural infinite family; its complete singular support has n coordinate strata and 2^(n-1)-1 Segre strata, with two different codimension regimes. The quotient types and parity-dependent Gorenstein structure give structural geometric invariants not obtained by simply substituting into the already-known degree or equations. The precise decomposition is useful for understanding singularity/resolution geometry; no downstream theorem is assumed.
